title: Derived sections comparison on complexes of associated sheaves
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, with chosen derived categories of A-modules and module sheaves on X=Spec(A) [def-pc-derived-category]. Let T be the associated-sheaf functor [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction], equipped with its additive structure, and let S be global sections with scalars transported along the affine global-sections ring isomorphism [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. For every K in the homotopy category of unbounded cochain complexes of A-modules, the canonical comparison Qh(S_h(T_h(K))) -> RS(Qh(T_h(K))) of the total right derived functor [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image] is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 06Z0, proof of Lemma 36.3.5: the cohomology calculation for the module unit b; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/06Z0

proof.text: Let T be tilde and S affine sections with scalar transport. Prove the general categorical kernel lemma: for a fully faithful zero-morphism-preserving functor between categories with zero morphisms, a kernel in the target that is isomorphic to an image object lifts to a kernel fork in the source; full faithfulness reflects its limit property, proving preservation of this kernel. Specialize this proved private lemma to tilde. The kernel of tilde(f) is quasi-coherent, so its invertible ordinary counit supplies the required image-object isomorphism. Since T is a left adjoint preserving biproducts it is additive and exact.

Every quasi-coherent sheaf M is S-acyclic. After the exact conservative forgetful functor V to abelian groups, affine vanishing gives zero positive-degree classical derived sections. Use rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso V and the homologyRightDerivedFunctorObjSingleFunctorIso comparisons to identify these zero objects with V(R^q S(M)). Faithfulness of V reflects the vanishing of the identity map, giving R^q S(M)=0.

Construct the canonical unbounded adjunction a of exact T with RS. For the bounded-below derived adjunction, the ordinary unit is invertible and T sends injective modules to S-acyclic quasi-coherent sheaves by the previous step. Apply the proved source theorem isIso_derivedPlus_unit_app_of_rightAcyclic. Restrict a along the full inclusions of the bounded-below derived categories, using mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompatibility and rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility. Uniqueness of right adjoints transports the invertible bounded-below unit to this restriction. The restriction unit formula then gives invertibility of a.unit on every bounded-below object.

For arbitrary derived P and integer n, let pi:P -> truncGE n P. Exactness of T identifies H^i(T(P)) with tilde(H^i(P)), so T(P) has quasi-coherent cohomology. The affine sections truncation theorem makes H^n(RS of the truncation projection of T(P)) invertible. Exactness of T also supplies mapDerivedCategoryTruncGEIso, whose inverse composes with that projection to T(pi). Thus H^n(RS(T(pi))) is invertible. The object truncGE n P is bounded below, hence its unit is invertible by the previous step. H^n(pi) is invertible. Apply H^n to naturality of a.unit for pi and cancel these three isomorphisms to deduce invertibility of H^n(a.unit P). The derived homology criterion proves that a.unit P is invertible.

Apply derivedη_fac_app to the ordinary homotopy adjunction T_h ⊣ S_h at K. It expresses a.unit(Qh K) followed by RS of mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh as Qh of the ordinary homotopy unit followed by S.rightDerivedFunctorUnit at T_h(K). The left side is invertible by the previous step and the exact-functor comparison. The ordinary homotopy unit is invertible by full faithfulness of T_h. Cancel it to obtain the asserted invertibility of the right-derived-functor comparison.

theorem affineTildeDerivedSectionsUnit_isIso (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [(tilde.functor (.of A)).Additive]
    (K : HomotopyCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) :
    IsIso ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace ⋙
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv.hom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
        (((tilde.functor (.of A)).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K))
